text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Today is Windy-chan's birthday, nodaa~! 
All my minions, feel free to celebrate 
with a big bang, noda!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okaay! Understood☆ Minion No. 1 will do 
her best~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(D-Did she just say—'nanoda'!!? That 
wasn't just some convenient auditory 
hallucination, was it...!?)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, boss and lackey basically 
translates to leader and member, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, to make our leader's individuality 
stand out, I thought matching might be a 
great idea too☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Make me... stand out?! I mean—w-well, 
that's not bad at all, noda! If that's the 
case, Digital will do it too, noda!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? WHAAAAAT...?!? Me too?! Are you 
really sure about this...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course you do! Otherwise, you're 
disqualified from the Windy Corps~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood...! Henchman Number Two will 
do her very best, unworthy as I may be... 
er, yes I will, noda!!
